commit.message:
feat(ci): olve/ci says when a run is waiting and when it was cancelled

A new head that will run on the active version gets pending 'Waiting to
start' right away (one compare per push decides it doesn't change the
definition); a waiting head that gets no run says why (a conflict, no
CI). A run of the current head that is cancelled reports error
'Cancelled' instead of leaving the check pending.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <<scrubbed>>

feat(ci): open pull requests run again when the checks change

When the active version's ci section or code hash differs from the one an
open, ready pull request's latest run used (not its own build), the pull
request runs again by itself, at a priority between ready pull requests'
own runs and drafts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <<scrubbed>>

fix(ci): auto-merge puts a pull request back in the queue on a new head

The queue only enqueued when auto-merge was turned on, so a pull request
pushed to, or removed by a failed batch and then fixed, stayed out while
auto-merge stayed on. Now auto-merge also asks for the queue on a new
head, out of draft and on reopen; one removed at the same head stays out.

Docs: drop the unbuilt pl ci merge from the queue description, and the
publishing policy lands PRs with auto-merge, as ovea-workstyle says.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <<scrubbed>>
